sources.shortCitation: Jack Hylton, “Herr Lehmann, Herr Lehmann” (Challenge reissue, via YouTube)
sources.fullCitation: The Jack Hylton Orchestra, directed by Jack Hylton, with Jack Jackson, Philippe Brun and Leo Vauchant. “Herr Lehmann, Herr Lehmann, Was Macht Die Frau Gemahlin In Marienbad?” On “Hot Hylton” 1926–1930, Challenge Records International, ℗ 2000, released 1 January 2000; art track supplied to YouTube by The Orchard Enterprises and published on the auto-generated artist channel on 10 February 2015. The reissue does not identify the original disc. Accessed 20 August 2026.
sources.title: Herr Lehmann, Herr Lehmann — Jack Hylton, Challenge reissue

sources.fullCitation: Jack Hylton und sein Orchester, Refrain: Siegfried Arno. “Das verliebte Orchester.” Fox-Trot; label credit “Text und Musik von Fritz Rotter und Dr. B. Kaper”. Electrola, Katalog-Nr. E.G. 2259, n.d. The label carries the matrix number (60-1496), the B.I.E.M. mark, the speed 78 UMDR. and the designation Tanz-Orchester mit Refraingesang; the uploader dates the issue to 1931 and links the Paul von Beky version of the same song. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Das verliebte Orchester — Electrola E.G. 2259
